# Adjusted offending estimates, full report (fixture)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

Full report. We estimate group differences in registered offending with and without
controls for age, sex, socioeconomic status and urbanisation. The unadjusted differences
are substantial; the adjusted differences are substantially smaller and for several
groups and offence types not distinguishable from zero. We present offence-specific
estimates with confidence intervals and a discussion of reporting behaviour and of the
difference between suspects and convictions.
